Timing.description:
When cash flows arrive within each period.

Rates are always decimal fractions per period: `0.10` means 10%.

oneOf.description: Cash flows at the end of each period (t = 1, 2, ..., n).
Cash flows spread evenly, discounted at mid period (t = 0.5, 1.5, ...).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate (WACC) per year as a decimal fraction (0.09 = 9%).

free_cash_flows.description: Free cash flows to the firm for explicit forecast years 1..n.

net_debt.description: Net financial position: debt minus cash. Negative if net cash. Default 0.

non_operating_assets.description: Non-operating (surplus) assets added to equity value. Default 0.

terminal_growth.description: Perpetual growth rate after year n as a decimal fraction. Must be below the discount rate.

timing.description: When cash flows arrive within each year. Default: end of period.
